cases.title: Contagion reversed
cases.question: Did people in 1842 think consumption was contagious?
cases.answerExcerpt: Mostly not, in Britain… Wikipedia states that the disease spreads through the air, and that Robert Koch identified the bacterium in 1882.
cases.diagnosis: Retrieval found the one passage on each side that discusses contagion (B5, W3) and the reranker put both first, even though the titles differ.
cases.lesson: The pipeline works when each source states the claim plainly in a single passage.

cases.title: What 1797 got wrong
cases.question: What did people in 1797 get wrong about blood?
cases.answerExcerpt: Three claims in the 1797 entry no longer hold: blood made from chyle, heat from fermentation, bloodletting as routine treatment.
cases.diagnosis: Each wrong claim was paired with the modern passage that replaces it, and every sentence carries a citation.
cases.lesson: Broad "what changed" questions work when the page is short and the match is strong.

cases.title: Same word, different thing
cases.question: Is 'inoculation' in 1778 the same thing as a vaccine today?
cases.answerExcerpt: No. In 1778 "inoculation" meant ingrafting real smallpox matter, which still killed some patients. The first vaccine used cowpox instead.
cases.diagnosis: The agent separated a word that survived from a practice that changed, citing both sides.
cases.lesson: With both texts in view, the agent can tell a change in language from a change in knowledge.

cases.title: Wrong article retrieved
cases.question: What is the modern view of animal spirits?
cases.answerExcerpt: Today "animal spirits" describes the emotions and instincts that drive economic decisions…
cases.diagnosis: The question embedding matched the economics article on the shared title. The reranker scored it 0.12, but the agent answered from it anyway.
cases.lesson: Answers must respect the rerank threshold, and queries should include the Britannica passage text, not just the headword.

cases.title: "The last century" misread
cases.question: When was blood transfusion first tried?
cases.answerExcerpt: According to the 1797 entry, transfusion was first attempted in the 18th century…
cases.diagnosis: Written in 1797, "the last century" means the 1600s. The agent read the relative date from today's point of view.
cases.lesson: Give each passage its publication year in the prompt, and resolve relative dates when the page is parsed.

cases.title: Missed because of the long s
cases.question: How was smallpox treated in 1778?
cases.answerExcerpt: The 1778 entry does not describe a treatment for smallpox…
cases.diagnosis: The page prints "ſ" (long s), so the parsed text read "frefh air" and "purging" came out garbled. The treatment passage never reached the top results.
cases.lesson: Normalise ſ to s and common OCR confusions before embedding.
